label: hot web
says: what the world is reading right now
note: a page many people read is not an important or a true one

label: editors' choice
says: the article Wikipedia's editors chose for today
note: a featured article meets Wikipedia's own standard; it is not this estate's recommendation

label: editors' choice
says: the picture Wikimedia Commons chose for today
note: the terms shown are the ones Commons states for the file; reusing it is between the reuser and its author

label: almanac
says: what happened on this date in other years
note: an event recorded for a date is an encyclopedia's account, not a verified one

label: photographers
says: pictures the Commons community voted its best, newest first
note: a featured picture is the Commons community's choice; the terms are what Commons states for each file

label: photographers
says: photographs of Fort Worth and Dallas that the Commons community rated for quality, newest first
note: a photograph's place is where its camera said it was; it does not show who or what is in it or that it is current

label: gazetteer
says: landmarks and neighbourhoods of Tarrant and Dallas counties, most written-about first
note: a place here is what Wikidata records about it; it is not a boundary, a property record, an address or a recommendation to visit

label: film archive
says: films old enough to belong to everyone, whole, newest first
note: a film's public-domain status is what Wikidata records for the United States; it plays from Wikimedia Commons and is not hosted here

label: music archive
says: recorded music, from symphonies to songs, that anyone may hear
note: a recording plays from Wikimedia Commons under the terms its file page states; the composer is who Wikidata records, not the performer

label: film archive
says: feature films the Internet Archive holds, most watched first
note: an item the Archive hosts is not thereby public domain; its stated licence, where it has one, is shown as stated

label: live music archive
says: concerts recorded in Dallas and shared by tapers, newest first
note: a live recording is shared under the band's taping policy as the Archive records it; it is not a release or a licence

label: 78 rpm archive
says: blues, jazz, country and folk records digitized from 78s
note: a digitized 78 is preserved by the Archive for research; its rights in any use are the reuser's to establish

label: species sightings
says: plants and animals people photographed around Fort Worth and Dallas in the last month
note: a research-grade sighting is a community identification at a place and time; it is not a survey, a range or a hazard

label: podcast feed
says: the show about podcasting's open namespace, with chapters, transcripts and guests
note: a person or place an episode names is the show's statement; a transcript is the show's, not a verified record

label: podcast index
says: episodes just published across open podcast feeds
note: an episode listed by the index is its publisher's claim; reading it needs the operator's own Podcast Index key

label: podcast feed
says: a show about making podcasts, with chapters and transcripts
note: a person or place an episode names is the show's statement; a transcript is the show's, not a verified record
